text: Bizarre Love Polygon is love mapping with zero tracking 💗
Five hearts, four continents, one very dramatic polygon 💞 Make yours into a cute story card with blurred spots and Polly smiling along ✨
From a cherry-blossom crush in Kyoto to a sunny Lisbon maybe 🌸➡️🌻 Pin every heart, watch your polygon stretch, and share it with the spots blurred 💕
No signal, no problem 📵💕 Install Bizarre Love Polygon on your phone and pin that window-seat crush mid-flight, with Polly cheering you on ✨
Plot twist: this polygon ends in Cape Town 🌻💗 Map every crush, kiss and maybe, peek at your stats, then share a cute card with the spots blurred ✨
New phone, same heart 📱💗 Restore your encrypted backup and every pin comes home, from a snowy Montreal crush to that Seoul situationship 🥺✨
Month by month, 5dollars shows if your household saved or overspent, down to the cent 💸✨ No account, no server, just your own file. Try it! 🐷💕
Trip, wedding or renovation? Group its moves into an Epic and 5dollars totals them by category, account and month 🧳✨ Adventures, but tidy! 🐷💚
Tango crush in Buenos Aires, northern-lights kiss in Reykjavik, still complicated in Istanbul 💃🌌 Turn your polygon into a cute card, spots blurred 💗
Your ID shows 2 surnames, but your family tree hides heaps more 🌳✨ Kibi lines them all up in order on one cute card, with a "_" for each gap. What's hiding in yours? 💌
Your ID shows 2 surnames, but your tree hides way more! 🌳 Line them all up in order, and Kibi gives you a clue about who to research next to fill that first "_" 🔍✨
Your whole family as one round cookie 🍪💕 Parents and grandparents in pastel rings around you! Import a GEDCOM or bake your tree by hand, then share it ✨
